pull.title: KAFKA-20834: Add toString test coverage for Bytes
pull.body:
`BytesTest` covered `equals`, `hashCode`, `compareTo`, `wrap`, and the constructor, but `Bytes.toString()` had no test. This adds a test for its hex-escaping behavior:

- printable ASCII (0x20–0x7E) is kept as-is
- backslash (0x5C) is intentionally hex-escaped to `\x5C`
- control and high bytes are escaped to uppercase `\xHH`
- empty input and mixed printable/non-printable input are covered

No production code changes; unit test only, with no external dependencies.

This is my original work and I license it to the project under the project's open source license.

Reviewers: Uros (github:uros-b), Andrew Schofield <aschofield@confluent.io>
